verdict.rationale: Xero documents built-in AI automations that run without the user: JAX categorizes and matches bank transactions while the user is busy, bills forwarded by email become draft bills automatically, and duplicate bills are flagged automatically. These are fixed, vendor-defined automations, not user-configured ones, and drafts still await approval. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or rule setup, triggers and recurring schedules, controls over autonomous agent runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Let JAX categorize and match transactions while you're busy with your real work.
Automate bill entry by uploading files directly to Xero or forwarding bills from your email. Xero's AI extracts the key details to create draft bills ready for approval.
Detect and flag duplicate bills automatically to minimize fraud and payment errors
Pay multiple bills at once and automate reconciliation ensuring records are always up-to-date.
